core_obligations: Reduce Delta representability to representing the setoid functor Y
Verify axioms [0]-[5] for Y by transferring each from X via the fibre product
Apply the functor diagonal proposition and conclude with lemma-diagonal-representable

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce Delta representability to representing the setoid functor Y

difficulty_reason: Proves X is an algebraic stack in two stages: first Delta is representable by applying the representability criterion to the setoid fibre product Y = X x_{Delta, X x X, y} (Sch/V), whose class functor satisfies the axioms - [0] by sheaf-ness of setoid stacks, [1] by limit preservation transfer, [2] by (RS) transfer through the fibre product, [3] by finite-dimensionality, [4] by effectiveness, [5] by openness of versality for Delta_X - so Y is an algebraic space by the functor diagonal proposition; then lemma-diagonal-representable finishes.
